name: clarity

plugins.name: clarity-theme
plugins.description: A calm, high-legibility theme for Claude Desktop: colorblind-safe status colors, strong focus rings, easy on the eyes for long sessions.

plugins.name: neon-noir
plugins.description: A neon-noir theme for Claude Desktop: blue-black night surfaces, electric cyan and hot magenta accents, and a quiet skyline in the rain behind the chat. Light and dark.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Quiet productivity: an attention band for failing tests, uncommitted work and context fill; a risky-command guard; a changed-files pane; a usage chip that explains time, cost and context when clicked.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: A control room for many concurrent sessions: a factory-floor pane grouped by project, a needs-you queue with one batched notification, a per-project color tint, a collision radar, and Home: a briefing of what every session did while you were away.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: A soft IDE beside the chat: the session folder's file tree, a live viewer that follows what Claude reads, edits, searches and runs, and an activity strip.

description: Clarity for Claude Desktop: a calm, high-legibility theme plus plugins for attention, safety, multi-session control and a live IDE pane.
